name: 3 · Consents and certificates: watch → remind → verify

parameters.content:
## 3 · Consents and certificates: watch → remind → verify
Daily: work out where every record stands. Consent renewals follow the renewal timing in section 124 of the Resource Management Act (the months are settings, because the rules are being changed). Certificates, vehicle checks and insurance use 30-day and 7-day warnings.
Reminders get closer together as the date nears. Expired or missing records tell the operations manager what not to assign until a person has sorted it.

### Daily 07:00 NZ (or from the console): watch the register
One summary to the admin, one "do not assign" alert to the operations manager, and a reminder to each person responsible.

### Person opens the upload link
A photo or PDF of the renewal, and its new expiry date.

### Person uploads the renewal
Stored under files/register. The register keeps the old expiry date until a person has verified the upload.

### Admin verifies or sends back (console button)
Verified: the register takes the new expiry date and the reminders stop. Sent back: the person gets the reason and a fresh link.

### Owner records that a consent renewal was lodged (console button)
The agent then explains what that means for operating while the council decides: as of right, at the council's discretion, or not at all.

### View an uploaded certificate or consent
Opens the stored photo or PDF.

meta.description: Watches every consent, certificate, vehicle check and insurance date, reminds the person responsible on a tightening schedule, flags what not to assign, and lets a person verify each renewal.
